abstract: A case of orchioblastoma in a two-and-one-half-year-old boy treated with orchiectomy and lymph node dissection is presented. Review of previously reported cases of orchioblastoma and embryonal cell carcinoma in boys reveals that these tumors differ in histologic appearance, but their pathophysiologic behavior and prognosis are similar. As with embryonal cell carcinoma, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection has improved the survival of patients with orchioblastoma.
abstract_ja: 2歳半の男児の精巣芽腫の症例を提示し、精巣摘除術とリンパ節郭清で治療した。男児における既報の精巣芽腫と胎児性癌を検討すると、組織学的像は異なるが、病態と予後は類似している。胎児性癌と同様に、後腹膜リンパ節郭清により精巣芽腫患者の生存が改善している。
